name: Parakeet-unified-en-0.6b — GPU-PB Baseline Config on Gold-92
short_description: Per-clip STT predictions from nvidia/parakeet-unified-en-0.6b with the default GPU-PB TurboBias config (alpha=1.0, context_score=1.0, depth_scaling=2.0, 72 casing-expanded domain phrases) on all 93 gold-92 clips. Control condition for the t0019 biasing-improvement experiments.
model_description: nvidia/parakeet-unified-en-0.6b via NeMo ASRModel, greedy_batch decoding, GPU-PB TurboBias boosting_tree with the production-default hyperparameters, reproducing the t0017 biased baseline.

files.description: Per-clip STT predictions on all 93 gold-92 clips at the default GPU-PB config.
